description: Graph-native top-down structural confabulation over the observed Doom map. Partial passable SpaceQuantum boxes are decoded as room/corridor/minimal-enclosure hypotheses; rules project complete unseen wall structure at the same tick as bottom-up accumulation. Later ObsCells mint confirmation or prediction-minus-observation residuals. Predictions never write has_cell.

microtheory.name: doom_predictive_priors
microtheory.description: partial spatial evidence -> whole room/corridor hypothesis -> projected walls -> residual

rules.name: dpp_project_room
rules.comment: TOP-DOWN room: decode a partial passable quantum and immediately project the schema's unseen wall structure. This deliberately predicts more than has been observed; no has_cell belief is written.

rules.name: dpp_confirm_wall
rules.comment: Compare a later bottom-up observation with the preceding top-down wall projection; mint a durable confirmed outcome.

rules.name: dpp_correct_wall_to_free
rules.comment: Compare a later bottom-up observation with the preceding top-down wall projection; mint a durable corrected outcome and prediction-minus-observation residual.
